title: Structure Mode floating node panel
description:
When Structure Mode is on, PipeSync now shows a floating Structure nodes panel. You can set the default placement size for new nodes, browse every node on the board, and click a row to jump the PDF Viewer to that page with the node in view.

Right-click the list to enter Select nodes mode (Windows-style: click, Shift+click range, Ctrl+click toggle). With a selection, right-click again for Adjust node size — slider, +/−, or type a value — then Apply (exits edit mode) or Cancel (keeps selection).

Who is affected: PipeSync Map Building + PDF Viewer on pipeshare.live (BASE). SaaS unchanged until cPanel apply.

Hard-refresh PipeSync, turn on Structure Mode, and use the panel on the left.
changeLog: Structure Mode floating panel: placement size + full node list.
Click a list row to open PDF Viewer on that node’s page and center it.
Right-click list: Select nodes with Windows-style multi-select.
With selection: Adjust node size (slider / +− / typed value), Apply or Cancel.
Per-node radius scales marker, label, and hit target; default placement size persists.
